messages:
deploy-bot: Starting staged deploy -> prod: release/rc-3e9a (regions: us-east-1, eu-west-1). Canary traffic 2% at 17:12 UTC.
eng-runtime-raj: watching canary
prod-incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: p95 latency increased in us-east-1 canaries >350ms, error spike ~5% on /v1/generate (17:15 UTC)
sre-oncall-maya: paging oncall — I’m on it. can someone grab the canary graphs?
eng-runtime-raj: grabbing dash now, past 5m shows sawtooth p95 and kernel-selector events. snippet:
```
[17:14:58] kernel_selector: selected=quant_opt_v3 fallback=true
[17:15:01] queue: microbatch_wait=45ms depth=18
[17:15:04] errors: 500=42 (spike)
```
platform-ops-ellie: seeing kernel fallback churn + microbatch timeouts in us-east-1. queue depth jumping at the same time.
sre-oncall-maya: sounds like the new adaptive-kernel-selector might be misrouting to a fallback path. that flag was included in rc-3e9a. recommend flip to legacy if safe? :thinking_face:
eng-runtime-raj: adaptive-kernel-selector=true in canary. flipping will force legacy kernel_path and avoid new batching path. can flip at will, but will need to coord with rollout.
sre-oncall-maya: flipping now (breaking glass) — adaptive-kernel-selector=false (by maya) at 17:18 UTC :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Flag toggle recorded: adaptive-kernel-selector=false (user: sre-oncall-maya) — propagation to canaries initiated.
prod-incident-bot: p95 latency in us-east-1 improved: 350ms -> 180ms within 45s of flag flip. error rate trending back to baseline.
customer-success-tom: seeing ticket from Acme Corp reporting slow responses ~17:15-17:20, they flagged degraded UX. any ETA to restore?
sre-oncall-maya: brief impact window, ~5-10% requests 500s. no data corruption. rolling canary back to previous release to be safe and stop rollout. initiating rollback now.
platform-ops-ellie: initiating canary rollback: rc-3e9a -> rc-3e8f in us-east-1 (and pausing eu target). ETA ~3m.
deploy-bot: Rollback job started: CI #67891. streaming logs:
```
[17:20:12] svc-orch: draining canary pods
[17:21:00] svc-orch: deploying rc-3e8f -> replicas=2
[17:22:40] svc-orch: canary healthchecks ok
```
eng-runtime-raj: added temporary microbatch-window bump to 20ms on canary proxy to reduce tail amplification in case any stray paths remain. will revert after stabilization.
sre-oncall-maya: canaries look healthy. p95 stable and error rate normalized. handing off to eng-runtime for follow-up and postmortem. cc: @eng-runtime-raj @platform-ops-ellie
eng-runtime-raj: got it — I’ll own the follow-up, run regression tests against rc-3e9a in staging, and kick off an eval suite for kernel-selector. will produce a postmortem and mitigation plan.
customer-success-tom: thanks — I’ll update Acme with a note: rollback completed, root cause under investigation, no data loss, apologies for the brief degradation.
prod-incident-bot: Incident resolved: canary rollback completed, p95 and error rate within baseline. Incident closed 17:27 UTC. :lock:
